text:
Zara (docs): Quick PR for Optimize toolkit: small fixes to batching examples, KV prefetch link, and a short quant note for very short prompts. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/612

Tom S.: Looking. The JS snippets still use embed_model; new SDK uses model. I'll push a one-line change.

Evan (eng): Also the Go example uses NewGenCall()  replace with request builder pattern. Suggested snippet:
```go
req := client.NewRequest().WithModel("redwood/opt-1").WithBatching(true)
resp, err := client.Generate(ctx, req)
```

Lia (perf): Perf guidance: interactive UIs: 20-30ms batching window; bulk jobs: 100-200ms. Noted in comment.

Zara (docs): DocsBot, can you run link check on the preview after Tom's change?

DocsBot: Preview build started: https://deploy-preview.redwood-inference.org/612. Link check: 1 broken -> /internal/prefetch-cheatsheet.

Tom S.: Updated link to ./prefetch/cheatsheet.md#examples and added a short qprofile example recommending fp16 for <64 tokens with a note to only enable 4-bit after regression tests.

Evan (eng): Added a tiny YAML showing fallback routing when batching breaches SLOs:
```yaml
routing:
  policy: prefer_low_latency
  fallback:
    - model: redwood/opt-1-lite
      reason: slo_violation
```

DocsBot: Re-run link check: 0 broken links. Build OK. Lint: no warnings.

Zara (docs): Approved. I'll add a one-line changelog entry and merge once CI completes. Thanks!
